parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Let this be a moment to rest. <short pause> Settle into where you are lying. <short pause> Let your body sink down into the surface beneath you. <short pause> Release the weight of your shoulders. <short pause> Let your jaw unclench. <short pause> Soften your eyes. <short pause> Take a slow breath in through your nose... <short pause> and let it go gently. <short pause> Again, breathe in slowly... <short pause> and release.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You have carried much today. <short pause> The weight of tasks, and thoughts, and worries. <short pause> You do not have to carry them into this night. <short pause> There is One who invites you to come just as you are. <short pause> Tired. Weary. Burdened. <short pause> He does not ask you to fix yourself first. <short pause> He does not require that you arrive strong, or sorted. <short pause> He simply says... come.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Breathe in that invitation now. <short pause> And as you breathe out... let your striving go.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Picture yourself standing at the edge of a worn path. <short pause> The way is gentle, sloping downward. <short pause> You begin to walk. <short pause> Each step is easy. <short pause> The ground is soft beneath your feet. <short pause> You are not rushing. <short pause> There is no hurry here.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The path leads you toward a place of rest. <short pause> Someone is waiting there for you. <short pause> He knows your name. <short pause> He knows what you have carried. <short pause> And he is not troubled by any of it. <short pause> Take another slow breath. <short pause> As you come closer, you hear his voice. <short pause> It is steady, and kind.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. <short pause> Matthew, chapter eleven, verse twenty-eight. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: This is not a command. <short pause> It is an offer. <short pause> Jesus does not pull you toward himself. <short pause> He waits. <short pause> He invites. <short pause> And when you come... he gives rest. <short pause> Not as a reward for effort... but as a gift. <short pause> Let yourself receive it now.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Breathe in rest. <short pause> Breathe out the weight you have been holding.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You do not need to solve anything tonight. <short pause> You do not need to plan, or prepare. <short pause> You are held. <short pause> You are safe. <short pause> The One who spoke the stars into being is watching over you. <short pause> He does not sleep. <short pause> He does not grow weary. <short pause> And he has made space for you to rest.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Let your breathing slow even more. <short pause> Let your thoughts drift, like leaves on water. <short pause> You can let go now. <short pause> The night is a gift. <short pause> Sleep is a mercy. <short pause> And you are beloved.

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: May the Lord give you rest this night. <short pause> May his peace cover you like a blanket. <short pause> May you wake tomorrow, knowing you are his.
